items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: Spears didn't tell you about that? No, he told me not.

ctx.x: I was learning. I was learning, damn it, after I had hit the numbers, so... Yeah. ...I got five pieces of drum music right home. Yeah? See both my eyes been affected after my eyes got bad. Yeah. I got five pieces of drum music right now. Yeah. Even the piano, simple beats, you know, layout. Yeah. It's a gift from God. Sure, yeah.

It's just in there. Well, listen, I think that'll be all we need. Okay? Yeah. So... I think that'll get enough to get a good story on here. You think I'll play all right? Yeah, fine. You come to rehearse tomorrow night or rehearse in the morning? Yeah. I'm gonna try to get there. Because we're doing that recording Saturday, see? Yeah. Try to come tomorrow night. I will.
